snapshot.text: A government-led health system now expanding universal health insurance. Main challenges: high out-of-pocket costs (about 28% of health spending), a shortage of specialists, and expected falls in donor funding for 2026/27. The 2007 Health Policy is under review.

priorities.title: Universal health insurance rollout
priorities.text: The government plans to keep enrolling needy households in the Universal Health Insurance Program, aiming to lower citizens' medical cost burden.

priorities.title: Local pharmaceutical manufacturing expansion
priorities.text: The 2026/27 budget of Sh1.8 trillion funds a pharmaceutical research laboratory and local drug production, including antiretrovirals at Tanzania Pharmaceutical Industries.

priorities.title: Health sovereignty and policy reform
priorities.text: Officials frame health sovereignty as a national security matter, and the Ministry is revising the 2007 Health Policy and the Health Services Management Act.

netherlands.text: Dutch and German hospitals are working with Benjamin Mkapa Hospital in Dodoma on specialised cardiac care over five years, coordinated by ZGT Overzee. Radboudumc also partners with Muhimbili.
